mapper.select: SELECT (started_at AT TIME ZONE #{zone})::date AS day, SUM(distance_meters) AS distance_meters, SUM(duration_seconds) AS duration_seconds, COUNT(*) AS run_count, MAX(distance_meters) AS longest_run_meters FROM runs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND started_at >= #{start} AND started_at < #{end} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance_meters), 0) AS distance_meters, COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds), 0) AS duration_seconds, COUNT(*) AS run_count, COALESCE(MAX(distance_meters), 0) AS longest_run_meters FROM runs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
